title: Harness X + Plugin X + SovX convergence contract
purpose: One authority and state-transition contract for distribution, installable plugins, asset-evidence wrappers, measurement, routing, history, change maintenance and paid delivery.

authority_map.Plugin X: installable packaging over the same declared capabilities
authority_map.SovX: asset evidence wrapper over admitted evidence

action_policy.READ_ONLY: agent-executable only when the capability contract permits it
action_policy.completion_rule: No completed state without executor evidence.

invariants: Payment never mints trust, measurement, acceptance, settlement, finality or admission.
SovX never upgrades upstream asset or rail state beyond admitted evidence.
UNMEASURED is distinct from FAILED, ABSENT, REJECTED and FALSE.
A signature proves origin and integrity, not truth.
Corrections supersede prior records; published evidence is not silently rewritten.
Discovery or catalog presence is evidence about reach, not endorsement.
Mutable external claims require structured measurement time or explicit UNCHECKABLE freshness.
Settlement requires settlement evidence; transaction evidence alone is insufficient.
FINAL requires measured finality; scheduled, proposed or code-only evidence cannot advance to deployed or live.
A delivery record may bind exact response bytes after confirmed settlement but remains distinct from the signed x402 receipt.
A UI run finishing does not imply an external effect; PAYMENT_REQUIRED remains review-required.
The sole production writer must receipt the exact upload tree or a documented post-build transform.

required: model or executable digest where applicable
producer_contract.rule: A producer may prove that work ran. Only the admission authority may turn eligible producer evidence into admitted measurement.

freshness_contract.rule: Serve, build and deploy time do not refresh evidence time.

interpretation.measurement: A bounded observed result under a declared method and evidence state.
interpretation.admission: An authority decision over eligible evidence, separate from producer completion.
interpretation.wrapper: A projection of admitted evidence that may narrow claims but may not upgrade them.
interpretation.delivery: The response or artifact actually emitted to a consumer.
interpretation.receipt: Evidence about a commercial or delivery event; not a truth or quality verdict.
interpretation.supersession: A later record that preserves the earlier published record and explicitly replaces its current standing.
